verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a CLI tool and GitHub Action, so it has no web API (OpenAPI probes all return 404). It does ship versioned releases, with features tied to versions such as composite rules in v8.28.0. The Action docs include one upgrade note stating there are no changes to inputs, outputs, or behavior, which hints at interface-stability awareness. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a versioned API surface or interface-stability guarantees, and changelog or migration guidance for breaking changes.
